event: He sits on the bench beside the well in the cobbled square.
Pigeons pick at the cobbles round the well.
A few townsfolk cross, unhurried, between the hall steps and the green shop door.
A woman stops at the well, draws a bucket of clear water, and nods to him on the bench.
She carries the dripping bucket off up the hall steps.
A man cuts through the pigeons; they scatter, then settle back round the well.
A carter pulls his loaded cart into the square.
The carter calls across the square for a hired sword, and waits for anyone to answer.
